recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not narrow the current value set back to two codes; not-done is a later approved evolution while the original broad-status concern remains resolved.
issue_request: FHIR-9070 was a Published FHIR-core Immunization change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that Immunization.status stop using the full MedicationAdministration status value set because on-hold, in-progress, stopped, and similar codes were not relevant to immunization events.
initial_application: Commit 1212b3f471b75003758b78b258e740eed23a98dd applied FHIR-9070 and FHIR-11122 by limiting the Immunization.status short list to completed and entered-in-error, pointing the binding at a new Immunization-specific value set, and adding that value set with only completed and entered-in-error from the then-current status code system.
additional_context: Later R4 work, reflected by commit 4c5a8902abffdfb5b6e9f07b4bca119d875dc64a, PHWG minutes, and FHIR-14377, changed the model from notGiven/reasonNotGiven to Event-aligned status=not-done/statusReason. Recent FHIR-54325 and FHIR-55330 decisions reaffirm the current three statuses and statusReason scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active source binds Immunization.status to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/immunization-status, whose compose includes completed, entered-in-error, and the later-approved not-done code from event-status, and excludes the broad MedicationAdministration statuses targeted by FHIR-9070.
